description: This file defines a PHP class `GoteoFilterAmount` responsible for database migration tasks related to adding and removing an 'amount' column in the 'filter' table. It contains methods for pre- and post-migration hooks, as well as methods to generate SQL statements for migration.

classes.name: GoteoFilterAmount
classes.description: A class that manages database migration steps for adding and removing an 'amount' column in the 'filter' table, providing SQL statements for both 'up' and 'down' migrations.

methods.name: preUp
methods.description: Hook method to execute code before applying the 'up' migration.

methods.name: postUp
methods.description: Hook method to execute code after applying the 'up' migration.

methods.name: preDown
methods.description: Hook method to execute code before reverting the migration.

methods.name: postDown
methods.description: Hook method to execute code after reverting the migration.

methods.name: getUpSQL
methods.description: Returns the SQL string to perform the 'up' migration, specifically adding the 'amount' column.

methods.name: getDownSQL
methods.description: Returns the SQL string to revert the migration, specifically dropping the 'amount' column.

calls: ALTER TABLE `filter` ADD COLUMN `amount` INT(10) NULL;
